summary: A sponsor tells colleagues why the person rewriting their bill still deserves their trust.
realLife: Humphrey publicly credited Dirksen’s intentions after Republicans fought over his amendments.
gates: The negotiator’s intentions have become a public issue.
inGame: needs: a public statement of trust tied to the named negotiator and current bill version.

turns.what: The sponsor credits the other member for one amendment and reserves judgment on the rest.
turns.pulledBy: The two have reached agreement on that provision alone.
turns.writesBack: The floor record identifies the extent of the endorsement.

turns.what: The sponsor gives credit after the negotiator delivers the agreed wording.
turns.pulledBy: An earlier draft left their bargain in doubt.
turns.writesBack: The endorsement names the text that settled the dispute.
